title: Escape
drDigitalIntro:
The Escape key backs you out of things.
• You will find it in the very top-left corner of your keyboard, often labeled Esc.
• Use it to cancel, close a dialog box, or leave a full-screen window.
• In menus and pop-ups, Escape closes them without doing anything.
• Go ahead and press it right now if you like. On this page it does nothing at all — like everything here, it is safe to try.
drDigitalSuccess: That is Escape: the 'never mind, back out of this' key.
drDigitalHint: Find Escape in the top-left corner (labeled Esc), then click Continue.
